sloka: अस्या हेतोर् विशाल अक्ष्या हतो वाली महा बलः ।रावण प्रतिमो वीर्ये कबन्धः च निपातितः ॥५-१६-७॥
transliteration: asyā hetor viśāla akṣyā hato vālī mahā balaḥ ।rāvaṇa pratimo vīrye kabandhaḥ ca nipātitaḥ ॥5-16-7॥

translations.english: "It was for the sake of this largeeyed Sita that the powerful Vali and the heroic Kabandha who was equal to Ravana in heroism were killed.
